title: ChatParty
description: chat.party@1 (Agent Streams S7): a watch party on a public agent stream or its VOD. A party is a Chat room of kind 'party' where friends watch in sync with their own chat beside the stream's. On a VOD the position follows the host's; on a live stream it follows the live edge, so there is no position to keep. A party is private by default: joining is by its link, and it may be listed on the stream's page as a count only ('3 parties watching') — names are never in that count. The id is the room's slug.

id.description: The party room's slug (its room id in Chat).

agent_stream_id.description: The public agent stream the party watches.

vod_id.description: Media's recording id when the party watches the VOD; null on a live stream.

host.description: The person whose position the party follows on a VOD.

mode.description: Live follows the live edge; vod follows the host's position.

position_s.description: The host's position on the VOD, in whole seconds. Absent on a live stream.

at.description: When the position was set; a reader adds the time since to a playing position.

visibility.description: Private by default: members only. 'link' lets anyone with join_url in; neither makes the party a directory entry.

listed.description: Whether the stream's page counts this party. The count carries no names.

join_url.description: The party's link, the one way in.
